RTS-R2-01.evidence: raw INFO stays observation-only in evaluate; arbitrary raw INFO can still acquire a Purple receipt through the process-event oracle

RTS-R2-02.evidence: lease attribute mutation is rejected; same path with a replacement directory identity is accepted

RTS-R2-03.evidence: stopped and restarted generations cannot sign; the exact running FIM public emit method can

RTS-R2-04.evidence: instance verifier mutation is ignored; class-level verifier mutation is accepted

RTS-R2-05.evidence: an established dialog rejects replacement; an older pair can win before binding establishment

RTS-R2-06.evidence: wall rollback cannot revive monotonic expiry; accepted maximum run duration exceeds the fixed TTL

RTS-R2-07.evidence: marker hardlinks and replacements fail closed; target directory identity is not held

findings.title: Missing mandatory probes disappear from a signed completed denominator
findings.recommendation: Bind preflight to the complete mandatory per-cycle plan, record failed and missing attempts, mark incomplete runs explicitly, enforce campaign order when selected, and refuse a coverage percentage or retain the planned denominator with missing probes counted as misses.

findings.title: Lease readiness pins a path string rather than target directory identity
findings.recommendation: Hold a no-reparse directory descriptor and volume/file identity from acquisition through release and verify the current path maps to that exact object at every consume, marker, scan, history, cleanup, and AAR boundary.

findings.title: Arbitrary INFO publisher becomes a Purple process-receipt oracle
findings.recommendation: Require an issuer-enrolled process challenge and exact Process Monitor producer/generation, bind token/PID/birth/held process identity to the run and step, and issue the receipt only from the canonical object-observation site.

findings.title: The exact running FIM object's public emit method remains a signing oracle
findings.recommendation: Remove signing from general emit and issue one-use receipts inside the actual FIM observation/classification site, bound to held file identity/content, scan generation, run, step, and event; isolate the signer from extensions.

findings.title: Mutable class-level dispatch bypasses detector receipts
findings.recommendation: Move scoring and verification to an isolated measured helper with a signer unavailable to extensions; fail closed on callable/code provenance drift as defense in depth and document that a mutable Python class is not an immutable same-process authority.

findings.title: Replay can win before the dialog establishes its run and digest binding
findings.recommendation: Return text/run/signed-JSON bytes and digest as one immutable generator result, bind before display, publish the pair through one authenticated atomic manifest, and keep a durable authenticated monotonic current-report head.

findings.title: Valid maximum-duration runs cannot fit inside the fixed monotonic lease
findings.recommendation: Derive a bounded monotonic deadline from the accepted preflight and settle budget or reject configurations that cannot fit; surface expiration as incomplete rather than producing coverage.

summary.interpretation: These are simulation evidence-integrity and completeness failures under the documented prerequisites, not proof of real exploitation or host compromise.
